headline: 7 ports can be reached from outside. ufw allows only 4 of them.
detail: Docker publishes the other 3 with rules of its own, which never pass ufw's list.

ports.title: Reachable from the internet. ufw does not allow it.
ports.why: A rule in chain DOCKER of table nat sends it on to 172.18.0.2:5432, container db. From there it is forwarded, not delivered to this machine, so the INPUT chain, where ufw keeps its list, never sees it.

deciding.rule: -A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.2/32 ! -i br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -o br-4c2f9a71d0e3 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 5432 -j ACCEPT
deciding.effect: accept

deciding.effect: accept
